notes.title: Make Your Reservation at Sker Hotel on July 28
notes.content:
[h1] Make your Reservation at the Sker Hotel! [/h1]

[b] Join us for the hotel's Grand Re-opening on July 28th, pre-order from July 21st on PC, PS4 and Xbox One. [/b]

At Sker Hotel we offer grotesque views, eerie forest trails, and blood-soaked beds. Be our guest but watch your step, make a sound and the Quiet Ones welcome you.

[previewyoutube=Ewkx5eBlOEs;full]https://youtu.be/yiC7Z7Ih27I [/previewyoutube]

Now you've seen sound devices in use, you've seen the breathing mechanic, the sound-based AI enemies, the inventory system... now we'd like to share a few details on the save system (a common question we receive!)

Yes, you can manually save your game via our Phonographs.

We welcome you to indulge in the use of the Phonographs, a device for the mechanical recording and reproduction of sound. Invented by Thomas Edison, the American inventor who gave us the Electric light bulb, it transitioned into the gramophone, which led to what we still use today — the vinyl record player.

Our Phonographs offer safety, allowing you to catch your breath and save your game, listen to the recordings and unlock the mysteries lurking within the Sker Hotel. 

Upgrade your stay by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940

Now the gates are opening, we will see you soon.

Wales Interactive

Web: https://www.walesinteractive.com/maidofsker
Twitter: https://twitter.com/WalesInter
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive

notes.title: 50% Off Don’t Knock Twice + Language Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478449/138ac8a05dff9d7badf830096bcc025fd4ac1972.jpg[/img]

[h1]Steam Sale[/h1]
Starting tonight at 6pm GMT, Don't Knock Twice will be [b]50% off[/b] in the Wales Interactive sale! 

[h1]New Languages Added[/h1]
Don’t Knock Twice now supports Arabic, Korean, Japanese and Chinese (Traditional).

[h1]Additional Patch Notes[/h1]
•	Aiming to interact with smaller objects is improved in Non-VR Version.
•	Reduced a massive CPU spike that could occur when lighting up candles.
•	Increased movement speed for Smooth Locomotion Controllers in VR Version.
•	Fixed a bug that was allowing you to interrupt the axe animation.
•	Fixed several places where players could get stuck in geometry in both versions.
•	Minor bug fixes and improvements.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/328590/Dont_Knock_Twice/

[h1]VR FEATURES[/h1]
Don’t Knock Twice is designed to be played with or without a VR device. 
Only one purchase is necessary, you will be given the option to play in VR or Non VR when starting the game. You are free to switch between modes and carry on where you left off. 

[h1]VR LOCOMOTION[/h1]
- "Hand-Forward" Locomotion
- "Head-Forward" Locomotion
- Teleportation

[h1]GAMEPLAY AREA[/h1]
- Seated 
- Standing
- Room-Scale

[h1]SUPPORTED CONTROLS[/h1]
Non VR – Keyboard / Mouse, Standard Controller
Vive VR – Vive Hand Controllers
Oculus VR – Oculus Touch Controllers, Standard Controller

[h1]ADDITIONAL VR FEATURES[/h1]
- Distance Grabbing or "Stretchy Hands" is an available option in Oculus VR Mode.
- Smooth Rotation or snap-rotation buttons are available in Oculus VR Mode.

If you'd like to keep in touch with the studio on social media, or follow all our news then head over to our [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] page. 

Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: UPDATE: New Languages, Studio Update & Physical Release
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1aGvkMH.gif[/img]

[h1]What's New[/H1]

Hello everyone!

You may have noticed a small update go live today and this is to feature two new languages now supported - Ukrainian and Turkish, provided by the community. We'd like to give a huge thank you to Юрій "BANDIT", Сергій "SeTuR" and AiBell Game Localization for their localisation support!

[h1]Demo Now Available[/h1]

We have had some requests from the community asking for the demo to be implemented into the game. The demo was built in an older version of Unity which is making it difficult to implement, however, we have uploaded the build into a separate branch of the game for you to download. To unlock the demo, please opt in to the beta by going to Steam Library > Right-Click Don't Knock Twice > Properties > BETAS and opt in to the "[b]demo[/b]" beta. Once downloaded, you are prompted to launch the main game or the demo. Please note, you may need to restart Steam for the demo to be visible. 

[h1]Dear Community...[/h1]

Don't Knock Twice has had an incredible launch and has been viewed by the hundreds of thousands on YouTube/Twitch from the likes of DashieGames, LIRIK, Daz Games, POiiSED, CoryxKenshin, Kuplinov and more! 

To anyone who has bought the game, reviewed it, streamed it or written about it then we'd just like to thank you for all your support and we hope to improve on this ambitious title to bring you even better games in the near future. We have a lot coming up and if you enjoyed Don't Knock Twice, whether you're a VR gamer or non-VR, you'll be in for a treat with something the team are working on right now. 

We tend to post regular news on [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/walesinteractive/]Instagram[/url] so feel free to follow us there to keep up to date with our studio news. You may get a glimpse of our unannounced titles! 

[h1]Getting Physical[/h1]

Finally, the following isn't PC related news but we thought we should share it anyway with the community here. We're proud to announce that Don't Knock Twice has been selected by a retail publisher to go physical on PS4/PSVR in shops worldwide, and will launch 20th October starting in Europe. The America launch will follow closely and pre-orders at GAME and Amazon are now available for Europe. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YegDz64.jpg[/img]

After a limited physical release of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/481110/]The Bunker[/url] on PS4, this is our first major retail edition and we couldn't be happier to bring more VR titles to the physical shelves. Currently, there's just not enough! Do you agree? We hope we can see more hit the shelves in 2018 and we hope to expand our retail editions to more platforms.

Keep an eye our for Don't Knock Twice in the shops, and if you do see it then take a picture and feel free to share it on our social channels listed above. 

[url=http://www.walesinteractive.com/]Wales Interactive[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/walesinteractive/]Instagram[/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/328590/

notes.title: VR UPDATE: New Locomotion, Smooth Rotation, Head Offset
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X35rBT5.gif[/img]

We're back with another (VR) update, this time featuring the some of the most requested features by the community! 

[H1]What's New?[/h1][list]

[*] [b]Hand-Forward Locomotion (Oculus & Vive)[/b] - Our most requested feature was to implement an additional style of locomotion. Sometimes referred to as "Onward" locomotion, now you have the option to point the controller in the direction you want to walk. Simply rotate the controller to strafe left and right, whilst being able to look around freely.

[*] [b]Smooth Rotation (Oculus Locomotion Only)[/b] - We recognise not everyone gets a weak stomach when playing in VR so you now have the option to turn on smooth rotation! Warning: for people who easily get motion sickness we recommend sticking with the 30 degree snap rotation.

[*] [b]Head Offset (Oculus & Vive)[/b] - Now the Head Offset feature is fully operational. While this game was optimised at the correct height, some setups may be calibrated slightly differently so if you're having trouble reaching the floor, please head into the options to tweak this slider.

[/list]
[H1]General Bug Fixes[/h1][list]

[*] [b]Oculus & Vive[/b] - Fixed an issue causing the "Read" hint not to appear on readable items for those with a standard controller. 

[*] [b]Oculus & Vive[/b] - Fixed an issue causing your character to rotate whilst you rotate objects in VR with a standard controller. [/list]

[H1]Oculus Store[/H1]

For anyone who purchased the game via the Oculus Store, we have now updated the build there to include all of the features in today's update, the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/DKT/announcements/detail/1444949197717945179]previous update[/url] and the initial locomotion update. 

[H1]SALE[/H1]
Wondering if now is the time to pick the game up? You just have one week to go in the Steam launch sale!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/328590/

[H1]Support the Game[/H1]

You can support the game by leaving your comments in the review section and letting others know if you recommend the game! 

Thank you all for playing and feel free to contact the dev team via our [url=http://www.walesinteractive.com/contact]website[/url] or leave your comments below. 

Wales Interactive

notes.title: UPDATE: Bug Fixes & Optimisation Pass
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1aGvkMH.gif[/img]

Hello everyone! We hope you're all enjoying your Friday and looking forward to the weekend! Listening to all the comments made here on the forums, we've found a few bugs which we wanted to patch before the end of the week. 

[H1]General Bug Fixes[/h1][list]

[*] [b]Localisation[/b] - French and Italian localisation updated.
[*] [b]Oculus & Vive[/b] - Fixed an issue causing the "Read" hint not to appear on readable items. 
[*] [b]Oculus & Vive[/b] - Fixed teleportation breaking after taking headset off.
[*] [b]Oculus & Vive[/b] - Fixed several occasions where turning locomotion on/off would cause it to break.
[*] [b]Oculus & Vive[/b] - Fixed multiple areas where collisions would cause you to get stuck in locomotion and teleportation.
[*] [b]Oculus & Vive[/b] - Disabled some graphics options which weren't used in VR.
[*] [b]Oculus Rift[/b] - Fixed the game pausing or going to black screen during the loading screen if you take the headset off.
[*] [b]Oculus Rift[/b] - Fixed an issue causing a crash when going to graphics settings with a standard controller.
[*] [b]General[/b] - Fixed lighting issues on some of the doors.
[*] [b]General[/b] - optimisation pass

Thank you all for your support with the game and feel free to contact the dev team via our [url=http://www.walesinteractive.com/contact]website[/url] or leave your comments below. 

Have a great weekend! 

Wales Interactive

notes.title: Release Date Announced and Pre-Orders Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478449/4a5e668bdb83aa581464bfd92a575b46438a5de0.jpg[/img]

[h1]IT'S COMING...[/h1]

[b]Don't Knock Twice is coming 5th September to HTC Vive & Oculus Rift!
 
Non-VR version also coming 5th September on PC.

Pre-Orders coming 8th August.

Launch Trailer coming 8th August.[/b]

August is finally here and so expect to see a lot of updates this month! For those who have been following the game you might have noticed the date has been pushed back from the original release so thank you for waiting and we hope you're excited for the upcoming launch on [b]5th September[/b]. :DKT2:

There's a number of reasons why we had to push the date back including some hurdles that came with porting the VR and non-VR version to several platforms, all using multiple controller setups. We've also been working hard on ironing out any frame rate issues so you won't get any vomit inducing moments. Finally (for any console gamers out there) we will have one additional announcement to make very soon! :DKT4:

[h1]GET IT EARLY, FOR LESS![/h1]

Don't Knock Twice will be getting the pre-order treatment starting 8th August with a pre-order discount applied! 

[h1]VR OR NON-VR... HAVE BOTH![/h1]

Can't decide which to choose? Or worried the game will be TOO scary in VR? Every downloadable copy of Don't Knock Twice will ship with both the VR and the Non-VR version. No separate store listings, no additional DLC needed.

ONE game, ONE download, ONE price, TWO versions. 

[h1]IMMERSIVE VR HORROR[/h1]

We're committed to giving you the best optimised VR horror visuals for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. We want you to be totally immersed in a haunting manor house environment for the ultimate horror experience. Check out the new screenshots and let us know what you think in the comments...

Keep an eye out on the forums, add the game to your wishlist and follow our [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] pages to catch the upcoming news, trailer and pre-orders! :DKT6:
